username.title: Username
username.description: Username to connect to AzureSQL. This user should have privileges to read the metadata.

hostPort.title: Host and Port
hostPort.description: Host and port of the AzureSQL service.

database.title: Database
database.description: Initial database to connect to. Metadata reading is restricted to this database unless Ingest All Databases is enabled, in which case this database is used as the entry point to discover and scan all databases.

authenticationMode.title: Authentication Mode
authenticationMode.description: This parameter determines the mode of authentication for connecting to AzureSQL using ODBC. If 'Active Directory Password' is selected, you need to provide the password. If 'Active Directory Integrated' is selected, password is not required as it uses the logged-in user's credentials. This mode is useful for establishing secure and seamless connections with AzureSQL.

authentication.title: Authentication
authentication.description: Authentication from Connection String for AzureSQL.

encrypt.title: Encrypt
encrypt.description: Encrypt from Connection String for AzureSQL.

trustServerCertificate.title: Trust Server Certificate
trustServerCertificate.description: Trust Server Certificate from Connection String for AzureSQL.

connectionTimeout.title: Connection Timeout
connectionTimeout.description: Connection Timeout from Connection String for AzureSQL.

ingestAllDatabases.title: Ingest All Databases
ingestAllDatabases.description: Ingest data from all databases in Azuresql. You can use databaseFilterPattern on top of this.

connectionOptions.title: Connection Options
connectionOptions.description: Additional connection options to build the URL that can be sent to service during the connection.

connectionArguments.title: Connection Arguments
connectionArguments.description: Additional connection arguments such as security or protocol configs that can be sent to service during connection.

schemaFilterPattern.title: Default Schema Filter Pattern
schemaFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include/exclude schemas that matches the pattern.

includes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and include only database entities that match.

excludes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and exclude only database entities that match.

tableFilterPattern.title: Default Table Filter Pattern
tableFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include/exclude tables that matches the pattern.

includes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and include only database entities that match.

excludes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and exclude only database entities that match.

databaseFilterPattern.title: Default Database Filter Pattern
databaseFilterPattern.description: Regex to only include/exclude databases that matches the pattern.

includes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and include only database entities that match.

excludes.description: List of strings/regex patterns to match and exclude only database entities that match.

supportsDatabase.title: Supports Database
supportsDatabase.description: The source service supports the database concept in its hierarchy

sampleDataStorageConfig.title: Storage Config for Sample Data
sampleDataStorageConfig.description: Storage config to store sample data
